model.sizes: k=2^(H-1), N=4k-1; dyadic k only, not every integer N.
model.physical: Complete rooted binary tree, maximum degree3; unique physical simple paths.
model.traffic: Exactly k^2 L-to-R leaf commodities, initial demand1 each, all other demands0.
model.design: Initial edge load/capacity k*k_e; fixed topology and strictly positive linear capacity-increment prices; all doubled initial demands must fit. Unique cheapest resulting C_e=2*k*k_e.
model.time: Real t>=1; each finite designed network then held fixed.
model.randomness: Independent X_ij~Exp(1), sampled once as quenched affine slopes. d_ij(t)=1+(t-1)X_ij; mean t, variance(t-1)^2. No fresh-time sampling or exponential-in-time demand.
model.optimizer: Maximize total admitted sum y with 0<=y_ij<=d_ij(t) and physical edge capacities; all optimizing admitted matrices.
model.marginal: r_k=right derivative F'_+(t)/S_k, S_k=sum X_ij>0 almost surely; denominator is realized slope, not k^2.
model.spare_graph: All N original vertices; edges whose admitted loads are strictly less than capacity; M largest component. M=1 when edgeless, not0.
